added.description: IOBoard.md (Outputs section, row 'Serial servo protocols out') and docs/Manifest.md:31 require S.BUS and other serial protocols on an output, 'one PIO program each' and 'one PIO program per serial protocol'. P5's main-chip PIO state machine budget (11 of 12), instruction memory budget (81 of 96 words), combinations and the 223-of-256 mix count contain no serial servo output, and P5 states neither a count for them nor an assumption. At the largest supported mix (all four ports bidirectional, socket and PPM) only 1 state machine (PIO0) and 15 words (PIO0) are free, so a serial servo output fits only as one state machine of at most 15 words bound after the others; with the socket as a PIO UART the number of such outputs the board supports is not stated. The count per protocol is not stated in the tree, so it is an assumption P5 has to state and add to the bind-order model. The earlier P5 critic raised the same omission (FU-2P56/003-P5-critic.json budget verdict 6) and the current return does not address it.
